_source.title: 获取总线
_source.remarks.text.0: 如若传入多个图元 ID，任意图元 ID 未匹配到不影响其它图元的返回，即可能返回少于传入的图元 ID 数量的图元对象
_source.params.primitiveIds: 总线的图元 ID，可以为字符串或字符串数组，如若为数组，则返回的也是数组
_source.returns: 总线图元对象，空数组表示获取失败

title: Get the bus
remarks.text.0: If multiple primitive IDs are passed in, a primitive ID that is not matched will not affect the return of other primitives; that is, fewer primitive objects than the number of primitive IDs passed in may be returned.
params.primitiveIds: Primitive ID of the bus, which can be a string or an array of strings. If it is an array, an array is also returned
returns: Bus primitive object; an empty array indicates that the retrieval failed
